verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs explicitly document rich search filters (sender, channel, date, has:image, channels:public) combined with keywords, directly supporting full-history search with filters (zulip-docs-3, zulip-docs-17, zulip-docs-23). However, community evidence disputes search quality/reliability in practice ('search function barely works'), and there is no evidence specifically confirming admin-scoped or full-organization history search versus per-user history limits.
